title: UNIUYO 2026/27 Post-UTME, Direct Entry, Admission Portal & School Fees
summary: University of Uyo's 2026/27 undergraduate screening notice asks first-choice UTME candidates with at least 150, and eligible first-choice Direct Entry applicants, to use the official admissions portal. Its published process separates account verification, Remita application payments, document uploads and printing a screening slip. Current school fees are not established by that notice.
feeLabel: Screening fee: confirm generated Remita invoice
feeNote: The 2026/27 UNIUYO screening announcement explains how applicants generate a Remita Retrieval Reference but does not establish a safe, universal screening-fee amount or 2026/27 programme-level tuition charge. Application form payment, school fees, accommodation and acceptance charges are different. Pay only the invoice issued to your account for the correct application or admitted-student session.
timeline: UNIUYO has published a 2026/27 Post-UTME/Direct Entry invitation and portal workflow. The checked announcement does not establish a trustworthy current closing date; verify whether the portal is still accepting that application type before paying. Admission and freshers-clearance dates are separate.
requirements: University of Uyo listed as first-choice institution on the 2026 JAMB record; 2026 UTME candidates need a score of at least 150 under the general notice, with individual departmental eligibility checked separately.
Direct Entry applicants need a first-choice 2026 DE record and a relevant approved higher qualification plus the department's O-level requirements.
A personal email address that the applicant can access to create and verify an admissions account; correct JAMB number, phone details and matching identity records.
Relevant O-level and DE evidence in PDF form when the current application requests supporting documents; verify uploaded results on the JAMB system as applicable.
steps: Read UNIUYO's official 2026/27 Post-UTME/Direct Entry notice and check its first-choice and general 150-UTME eligibility against the exact degree programme.
Open admissions.uniuyo.edu.ng from the university announcement, select the correct undergraduate UTME or Direct Entry application type, and check if that session is currently accepting submissions.
First-time users create an applicant account and confirm the email verification message. Existing users should sign in to their original portal account rather than register repeatedly.
Within the relevant application, select Application Fee, generate the Remita Retrieval Reference (RRR), and pay only the authentic charge linked to the applicant record.
Return to the portal, confirm payment, complete accurate biodata, O-level and DE fields and upload the required PDF documents.
Submit the completed screening form and print the 2026/27 acknowledgement/screening exercise slip; keep the applicant payment and confirmation records.
Check JAMB CAPS and the university's admissions account for a genuine provisional offer; successful screening form submission is not university admission.
If admitted, wait for current-session clearance instructions and generate personal acceptance, tuition and any hostel bills only from the authorised university systems.
notes: The university's 2026/27 notice states a 150 general UTME threshold; it does not promise admission or override any course-specific competition and subject combinations.
The applicant portal indicates that one account may manage multiple application categories; avoid creating duplicate accounts or using a third party's email.

The official undergraduate admissions page describes acceptable UTME/DE qualification routes; do not apply its general criteria as a guarantee for medicine, law or other highly competitive programmes.
The screening announcement provides an RRR procedure, not an evidence-backed 2026/27 school-fee table. MyNigeriaGuide does not collect fees, passwords or uploaded results.

title: AAU Ekpoma 2026/27 Admission, Course Cut-Offs, Portal & School Fees
summary: Ambrose Alli University Ekpoma's official 2026/27 undergraduate notice set a ₦5,000 application fee, a 1–30 June registration period and programme-specific UTME thresholds. Crucially, the university says there is no separate Post-UTME screening examination for this cycle. Applicants should check admission on JAMB CAPS and the current AAU ePortal; the older WAeUP/KOFA address currently shows an unavailability notice.
feeNote: AAU's ₦5,000 figure is the published 2026/27 undergraduate admission APPLICATION FORM payment, not acceptance, tuition, hostel or returning-student charges. University-specific 2026/27 programme and level fees were not confirmed by this notice. A student's actual school charges should be verified on the current authenticated AAU portal after an admission offer.
timeline: AAU announced applications from Monday 1 June through Tuesday 30 June 2026; the advertised regular application and document-upload window has ended. The linked newer university ePortal has a login/admission entry point, while the older WAeUP/KOFA portal currently displays an unavailability notice. Do not infer reopening.
requirements: AAU Ekpoma as first-choice institution on the 2026 JAMB record for the published ordinary admission form.

UTME result meeting the exact course threshold rather than assuming one cutoff for the whole university: examples include Law 260, Nursing 190, Computer Science 180 and Mechanical Engineering 160 in the 2026/27 official table.
All names typed in full, as the official instructions reject initials in the admission form.

O-level results and, for Direct Entry, A-level or relevant qualification results uploaded to JAMB CAPS by the published 30 June 2026 date; DE candidates were also told to complete their A-level verification via JAMB e-facility.
steps: Open AAU Ekpoma's signed 2026/27 admission release and compare the selected degree with its JAMB-score column; the second numeric screening column is not an additional paid examination.
Recognise that the advertised 1–30 June application window has passed. Do not pay agents for supposed October extensions unless the university publishes a new official notice.

Use the university-owned eportal.aauekpoma.edu.ng portal as the current starting point for sign-in or any genuine admission follow-up; verify the specific undergraduate route before entering credentials.
For applicants who submitted during the authorised window, check that the full-name and 2026 JAMB details match and that required O-level/DE qualifications are correctly recorded on JAMB CAPS.
Follow admission status through university communications and JAMB CAPS. A qualifying score is not the same as a confirmed admission offer.

Once officially admitted, obtain the current university's faculty- and level-specific acceptance/tuition instructions and personal fee invoice before paying; preserve receipts and clearance confirmation.

If directed to the old aaue.waeup.org/KOFA service and it displays its current unavailability statement, do not interpret the outage as lost student records or send money to an unverified migration website.
notes: AAU explicitly said there would be no separate Post-UTME SCREENING EXAM in its 2026/27 exercise; the admission application still existed and carried a ₦5,000 charge.

Official published 2026/27 example thresholds: Law 260, Nursing 190, Computer Science 180, Mechanical Engineering 160, and Mass Communication 200. Other programmes differ; the MBBS table cell is blank and should not be assigned an invented threshold.

The university's June notice referenced aaue.waeup.org, but its legacy provider currently displays a portal-unavailability statement. AAU's eportal.aauekpoma.edu.ng also provides a login and candidate route; check the university homepage for fresh instructions if service changes.
The 2026/27 application fee is NOT a school-fees invoice. Do not apply the regular June 2026 cutoff dates to later intakes without a newly issued statement.

title: RSU 2026/27 Post-UTME CBT, Biometric Screening & School Fees
summary: Rivers State University's signed 2026/27 notice requires a first-choice 2026 UTME score of at least 190 and relevant O-level credits for its Post-UTME CBT. Ordinary registration ran 18 May–7 June and screening began 15 June at the university ICT Centre, with biometric registration and a candidate-specific examination slip. Those dates are historical; don't pay for an alleged current reopening without university confirmation.
feeLabel: 2026/27 screening: fee not confirmed in the notice
feeNote: The 2026/27 university Post-UTME advert requires a debit-card registration payment through its own application portal but does NOT quote a numeric screening price. The ₦2,000 price appearing in older RSU screening years must not be treated as the 2026/27 fee. School tuition, acceptance and hostel charges are separate and need a current admitted-student account invoice.
timeline: The official 2026/27 screening registration period was 18 May–7 June 2026. The scheduled CBT commenced 15 June 2026; individual exam dates, times and venues were on the candidate's biometric examination slip. There is no confirmed current ordinary registration reopening in this notice.
requirements: Rivers State University as first-choice university for the 2026 UTME admission route.
At least 190 in the 2026 UTME under the university's published first-round rule; applicants must still satisfy the relevant faculty and departmental subject requirements.
Five required O-level credit passes, with results uploaded; awaiting-result candidates could apply, but RSU explicitly said no admission would be approved without the completed O-level result.
JAMB-consistent biodata and eligibility for the physical biometric capture/CBT appointment at Rivers State University's ICT Centre in Port Harcourt.
steps: Check the university's signed 2026/27 Post-UTME notice, confirming RSU first choice and a UTME score of at least 190 before relying on any guide.
Recognise that the advertised registration closed on 7 June 2026. Verify any later official supplementary or new-session announcement directly before attempting payment.
During an explicitly open university-authorised cycle, sign in or register at apply.rsu.edu.ng, use the university payment instructions and enter biodata exactly as recorded with JAMB.
Complete the required biometric verification through the RSU ICT Centre when instructed, then print the screening slip with individual exam date, time and location.
Attend the electronic CBT at the scheduled ICTC session. The university's notice says failure to attend the printed date and time makes a candidate ineligible for that screening.
Confirm an actual admission through RSU and JAMB CAPS, then use current faculty clearance and student registration instructions rather than the 2026 screening dates.
Pay only acceptance, tuition and accommodation invoices officially generated for the admitted student's programme and session; retain university-confirmed receipts.
notes: RSU's 2026/27 screening notice specifies FIRST-CHOICE UNIVERSITY and UTME 190+, not a generic nationwide 150 minimum.
RSU's official document lists screening start date but directs candidates to their own biometric slip for the exact CBT session.
No numeric 2026/27 screening payment is published in the checked advert; do not reuse a ₦2,000 amount from an older university document.
An official university-owned candidate portal exists. Its accessible landing page alone does not prove registration is open, and MyNigeriaGuide does not capture credentials or fees.
RSU's separate 2026/27 part-time CCE programme form has different dates and fees. Those are NOT ordinary Post-UTME undergraduate fees.
